entries.text: Brings mandrakes (an aphrodisiac) to his mother Ge 30:14
Commits incest with one of his father’ s concubines, and, in consequence, forfeits his birthright Ge 35:22; 49:4; 1Ch 5:1
Adroitly seeks to save Joseph from the conspiracy of his brothers Ge 37:21-30; 42:22
Jacob’ s prophetic benediction upon Ge 49:3,4
